```{r setup}
# ── Identify this park and load shared infrastructure ──────────────────────
park_id <- "sprague-brook"
source("../../R/setup.R")
source("../../R/parks_config.R")
source("../../R/fetch_weather.R")
source("../../R/fetch_streamflow.R")
source("../../R/fetch_nws.R")
source("../../R/mud_model.R")
source("../../R/snow_model.R")
source("../../R/plots.R")
source("../../R/mudface.R")
source("../../R/snowface.R")
source("../../R/fetch_evi.R")
source("../../R/og_card.R")
source("../../R/condition.R")
```

```{r fetch-data}
#| freeze: false
# ── Fetch all data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
weather_raw  <- fetch_weather()
if (is.null(weather_raw)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n**Weather data unavailable.** Conditions cannot be estimated at this time. Please check back later.\n:::")
  # knitr::knit_exit() only stops future chunks, not the current one.
  # Use else to guard all downstream code within this chunk.
  knitr::knit_exit()
} else {
  weather_mud  <- compute_mud_level(weather_raw) |> compute_snow_condition()
  stream         <- fetch_streamflow()
  stream_uv      <- fetch_streamflow_uv()
  weather_hourly <- fetch_weather_hourly()
  nws          <- tryCatch(fetch_nws_forecast(), error = function(e) {
    message("NWS fetch failed: ", e$message); .nws_empty()
  })
  snow_summary <- current_snow_summary(weather_mud)
  evi_data    <- tryCatch(fetch_evi(), error = function(e) {
    warning("EVI fetch failed: ", e$message); NULL
  })

  # Today's conditions
  today_row     <- today_mud(weather_mud)
  mud_now       <- today_row$mud_level          # raw mud score (0-10), used for forecast delta
  mud_score_now <- today_row$condition_score    # unified condition score (1-10)
  mud_label     <- today_row$condition_label    # "Avoid" / "Poor" / "Fair" / "Good" / "Great"
  mud_go        <- isTRUE(today_row$go_recommendation)
  mud_name      <- today_row$mud_level_name
  depth_cm      <- coalesce(today_row$snow_depth, 0)
  snow_score_now <- coalesce(snow_summary$condition_score, 1.0)
  snow_label     <- coalesce(snow_summary$condition_label, "Avoid")

  # Decide default tab: snow if winter months or snow on ground
  is_winter  <- month(Sys.Date()) >= 11 | month(Sys.Date()) <= 4
  show_snow  <- is_winter | depth_cm > 2

  last_updated <- format(Sys.time(), "%B %d, %Y at %I:%M %p %Z", tz = PARK_TZ)

  # Generate OG/social-media card image with today's conditions
  precip_7d <- weather_mud |>
    filter(date >= Sys.Date() - 7, date <= Sys.Date(), source %in% c("history", "era5")) |>
    summarise(total = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    pull(total)

  # 3-day mud forecast summary
  fc_rows <- weather_mud |>
    filter(date > Sys.Date(), date <= Sys.Date() + 3, source == "forecast")
  forecast_summary <- if (nrow(fc_rows) >= 1 && !all(is.na(fc_rows$mud_level))) {
    avg_fc <- mean(fc_rows$mud_level, na.rm = TRUE)
    delta  <- avg_fc - coalesce(mud_now, avg_fc)
    dplyr::case_when(
      delta < -1.5 ~ "Getting much drier",
      delta < -0.5 ~ "Getting drier",
      delta >  1.5 ~ "Getting much muddier",
      delta >  0.5 ~ "Getting muddier",
      avg_fc < 3   ~ "Staying dry",
      avg_fc > 6   ~ "Staying wet",
      TRUE         ~ "About the same"
    )
  } else {
    "Forecast unavailable"
  }

  generate_og_card(
    park_name            = park$name,
    location             = park$location,
    mud_condition_score  = mud_score_now,
    snow_condition_score = snow_summary$condition_score,
    go                   = mud_go,
    temp_f               = round(today_row$temp_max * 9/5 + 32),
    precip_7d_mm         = precip_7d,
    forecast_summary     = forecast_summary,
    output_path          = "og-card.png"
  )
}
```

## 🥾 Trail Conditions

```{r mud-hero}
#| output: asis

oneliner <- condition_oneliner(
  mode           = "mud",
  score          = mud_score_now,
  label          = mud_label,
  go_recommendation = mud_go,
  activities     = park$activities,
  frozen         = isTRUE(today_row$frozen)
)

# Go/No-Go banner
frozen_now  <- isTRUE(today_row$frozen)
if (frozen_now) {
  gonogo_class <- "tp-caution"
  go_text      <- "\u26a0\ufe0f Caution \u2014 Surface frozen, watch for ice"
} else if (mud_go) {
  gonogo_class <- "tp-go"
  go_text      <- "\u2705 Go \u2014 Trail conditions are acceptable"
} else {
  gonogo_class <- "tp-nogo"
  go_text      <- "\u274c No-Go \u2014 Please stay home to protect the trails"
}

# Numeric score and bar
score_display <- if (!is.na(mud_score_now)) round(mud_score_now, 1) else "?"
bar_pct       <- if (!is.na(mud_score_now)) round((mud_score_now - 1) / 9 * 100) else 0
rank_col      <- condition_color(mud_label)

# Quick stats
precip_7d <- weather_mud |>
  filter(date >= Sys.Date() - 7, date <= Sys.Date()) |>
  summarise(total = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total) |>
  round(1)
temp_today <- coalesce(today_row$temp_max, NA_real_)

# Render card
cat('<div class="tp-condition-card">')

# ── Main row: face + score ──
cat('<div class="tp-condition-main">')
cat(as.character(make_mudface(mud_score_now, size = "160px", label = FALSE, temp_c = today_row$temp_max)))
cat('<div class="tp-score-col">')
cat(glue(
  '<div class="tp-score-header">',
  '<span class="tp-score-num" style="color:{rank_col}">{score_display}</span>',
  '<span class="tp-label-pill" style="background:{rank_col}">{mud_label}</span>',
  '</div>'
))
cat(glue(
  '<div class="tp-score-bar-bg">',
  '<div class="tp-score-bar-fill" style="width:{bar_pct}%;background:{rank_col}"></div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="tp-score-endpoints"><span>1 — Avoid</span><span>10 — Great</span></div>'
))
cat('</div>')  # score-col
cat('</div>')  # condition-main

# ── Go/No-Go banner ──
cat(glue('<div class="tp-gonogo {gonogo_class}">{go_text}</div>'))

# ── One-liner description ──
cat(glue('<p style="margin:0">{oneliner}</p>'))

# ── Context row: forecast trend ──
if (exists("forecast_summary") && nchar(forecast_summary) > 0) {
  cat(glue('<div class="tp-context-row">\U0001F4C8 7-day forecast: {forecast_summary}</div>'))
}

# ── Stat boxes ──
cat('<div style="display:flex;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:0.5rem;">')
if (!is.na(temp_today)) {
  temp_f_today <- round(temp_today * 9 / 5 + 32)
  cat(glue('<div class="tp-stat-box">',
           '<div class="stat-value">{temp_f_today}\u00b0F ({round(temp_today)}\u00b0C)</div>',
           '<div class="stat-label">Today\'s High</div>',
           '</div>'))
}
cat(glue('<div class="tp-stat-box">',
         '<div class="stat-value">{round(precip_7d / 25.4, 1)} in ({precip_7d} mm)</div>',
         '<div class="stat-label">Precip Last 7 Days</div>',
         '</div>'))
cat('</div>')  # stat boxes

cat('</div>')  # condition-card
```

### Compared to Previous Years

```{r precip-percentile}
#| output: asis

# Cumulative precip so far this calendar year vs. historical
doy_now <- yday(Sys.Date())
ytd_now <- weather_mud |>
  filter(year(date) == year(Sys.Date()), date <= Sys.Date(), source %in% c("history", "era5")) |>
  summarise(total = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total)

hist_ytd <- weather_mud |>
  filter(year(date) < year(Sys.Date()), source %in% c("history", "era5")) |>
  mutate(doy = yday(date)) |>
  filter(doy <= doy_now) |>
  group_by(yr = year(date)) |>
  summarise(total = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pct_rank <- if (nrow(hist_ytd) > 0)
  round(100 * mean(hist_ytd$total < ytd_now)) else NA_real_

if (!is.na(pct_rank)) {
  direction <- if (pct_rank >= 50) "wetter" else "drier"
  cat(glue('<div class="tp-percentile" style="margin-bottom:1rem;">',
           'Year-to-date precipitation is <strong>{direction} than {pct_rank}%</strong> ',
           'of years since {year(WEATHER_START)}.',
           '</div>'))
}
```

## ❄️ Snow & Winter

```{r snow-hero}
#| output: asis

snow_one <- condition_oneliner(
  mode           = "snow",
  score          = snow_score_now,
  label          = snow_label,
  go_recommendation = go_recommendation(snow_score_now, "snow", "xc_ski"),
  depth_cm       = depth_cm,
  pct_rank       = snow_summary$snow_pct_rank
)

# Go/No-Go
snow_go <- go_recommendation(snow_score_now, "snow", "xc_ski")
if (snow_go) {
  snow_gonogo_class <- "tp-go"
  snow_go_text      <- "\u2705 Go \u2014 Conditions are good for Nordic skiing"
} else {
  snow_gonogo_class <- "tp-nogo"
  snow_go_text      <- "\u274c No-Go \u2014 Insufficient snow for skiing"
}

# Score and bar
snow_score_display <- if (!is.na(snow_score_now)) round(snow_score_now, 1) else "?"
snow_bar_pct       <- if (!is.na(snow_score_now)) round((snow_score_now - 1) / 9 * 100) else 0
snow_rank_col      <- condition_color(snow_label)

# Season stats
total_snow_this_season <- coalesce(snow_summary$cum_snowfall_cm, 0)
snow_days_this_season  <- if (nrow(snow_summary$current_season) > 0)
  sum(snow_summary$current_season$snowfall > 1, na.rm = TRUE) else 0

# Render card
cat('<div class="tp-condition-card">')

# ── Main row: face + score ──
cat('<div class="tp-condition-main">')
cat(as.character(make_snowface(snow_score_now, size = "160px", label = FALSE)))
cat('<div class="tp-score-col">')
cat(glue(
  '<div class="tp-score-header">',
  '<span class="tp-score-num" style="color:{snow_rank_col}">{snow_score_display}</span>',
  '<span class="tp-label-pill" style="background:{snow_rank_col}">{snow_label}</span>',
  '</div>'
))
cat(glue(
  '<div class="tp-score-bar-bg">',
  '<div class="tp-score-bar-fill" style="width:{snow_bar_pct}%;background:{snow_rank_col}"></div>',
  '</div>',
  '<div class="tp-score-endpoints"><span>1 — Avoid</span><span>10 — Great</span></div>'
))
cat('</div>')  # score-col
cat('</div>')  # condition-main

# ── Go/No-Go banner ──
cat(glue('<div class="tp-gonogo {snow_gonogo_class}">{snow_go_text}</div>'))

# ── One-liner description ──
cat(glue('<p style="margin:0">{snow_one}</p>'))

# ── Stat boxes ──
cat('<div style="display:flex;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:0.5rem;">')
cat(glue('<div class="tp-stat-box">',
         '<div class="stat-value">{round(depth_cm)} cm / {round(depth_cm * 0.394, 1)} in</div>',
         '<div class="stat-label">Snow Depth Now</div>',
         '</div>'))
cat(glue('<div class="tp-stat-box">',
         '<div class="stat-value">{round(total_snow_this_season)} cm / {round(total_snow_this_season * 0.394, 1)} in</div>',
         '<div class="stat-label">Season Total</div>',
         '</div>'))
cat(glue('<div class="tp-stat-box">',
         '<div class="stat-value">{snow_days_this_season}</div>',
         '<div class="stat-label">Snow Days</div>',
         '</div>'))
cat('</div>')  # stat boxes

cat('</div>')  # condition-card
```

---

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
### About the Mud Model

Trail muddiness is estimated from a weighted composite of the top 9 cm of soil
moisture (ERA5-Land reanalysis for history, Open-Meteo model for forecast days).

**Scoring:** A site-specific scale factor is applied to soil wetness, then a logistic
sigmoid converts it to an internal 0–10 mud index (0 = bone dry, 10 = impassable).
A precipitation boost applies when rainfall exceeds 5 mm in the prior 24 h.
The displayed **1–10 trail condition score** inverts the mud index
(score = 11 − mud index), so 10 = Great conditions and 1 = Avoid.

**Frozen:** flagged when the 3-day rolling mean of shallow soil temperature (0–7 cm)
drops to or below 0°C; single cold air-temperature spikes alone do not trigger it.

Calibration parameters (`midpoint`, `steepness`, `precip_boost`, `soil_moisture_scale`)
are set per park in `data/parks.yml`. The model has not been validated against field
observations — treat scores as estimates, especially near level boundaries.
:::
